name: Kellton Tech Solutions Ltd
about: Kellton Tech Solutions Ltd offers services in digital transformation, ERP and other IT services. It has operations across US, Europe, India and Asia-Pacific with a team of ~1,800 employees.[1]
keyPoints:
Services Offered
Agile software development, digital commerce & marketing, digital integration, outsourced product development, platform modernization, professional services, technology consulting, testing & automation and others.
[1]

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -3.11%
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 7.33% over past five years.
